prompt: Make a campaign for my paying users.

brief.audience: People who edit product photos, family shots, travel pictures, selfies, and social posts on their phone, especially on iPhone, in the US, GB, DE, CA, AU, NL, SE, and FR.
brief.hook: One tap turns a dull photo into a bright, sharp, well-lit version.
why: Apple Search Ads has 32.1% paid and $15.03/user, the strongest channel in the dataset.
People who make 5-7 AI edits on day one pay 33% and generate $15.47/user.
People who make 13+ AI edits on day one pay 35.8% and generate $16.97/user.
Product photos lead onboarding with 22.9% paid and $10.32/user.
The ai_limit_reached paywall placement converts 47.5% paid and makes $30.74/user.

concepts.name: Dull to vivid split
concepts.visualPrompt: A single smartphone photo of a plain product on a table, split down the middle: left half dull, flat, underexposed and soft; right half the same scene bright, sharp, well-lit and polished. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI.
concepts.headline: One photo, better light

concepts.name: Family photo glow-up
concepts.visualPrompt: A single candid family photo in a living room, natural scene, split down the middle: left half dim and slightly blurry; right half the same moment brighter, clearer, and warmly lit. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI.
concepts.headline: Make family photos shine

concepts.name: Travel shot refresh
concepts.visualPrompt: A single travel photo of a street café or landmark, split down the middle: left half dull and muted; right half the same scene vivid, sharp, and well exposed. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI.
concepts.headline: Travel shots, instantly polished

adCopy.headline: One tap, better photos
adCopy.description: Brighten and sharpen any shot fast.

adCopy.primaryText: Give your photos a cleaner look with bright light, crisp detail, and pro-style finishing. Easy for everyday shots on your phone.
adCopy.headline: Photos that look finished

adCopy.primaryText: From flat to polished in seconds. Lumen helps your photos look brighter, sharper, and ready to share.
adCopy.headline: Flat to polished

videoScript.hook: Watch a dull photo become bright and sharp in one tap.

shots.shot: A dim, soft photo appears on screen beside the same photo improved.
A single tap transforms the image to a brighter, clearer version.
Close-up of the finished photo with crisp detail and balanced light.
A row of different photo types appears: product, family, travel, selfie.
